user.title: Backup Manager Actions
user.description: Expose advanced Home Assistant Backup Manager operations to automations. No external credentials are required.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Backup Manager Actions instance can be configured.

create.name: Create backup
create.description: Create one Home Assistant backup and store it on all selected Backup Agents.

agent_ids.name: Backup agents
agent_ids.description: Backup Agent IDs that must receive the backup.

include_homeassistant.name: Include Home Assistant
include_homeassistant.description: Include the Home Assistant configuration in the backup.

include_database.name: Include database
include_database.description: Include the Home Assistant database when Home Assistant is included.

include_all_addons.name: Include all add-ons
include_all_addons.description: Include every installed add-on. Do not combine with selected add-ons.

include_addons.name: Selected add-ons
include_addons.description: Optional list of add-on slugs to include.

include_folders.name: Folders
include_folders.description: Optional Home Assistant folders to include.

name.name: Backup name
name.description: Optional backup name. Home Assistant generates a default when omitted.

password.name: Backup password
password.description: Optional password used to protect the backup.

delete.name: Delete backup
delete.description: Delete a backup from every Backup Agent, or only from explicitly selected agents.

backup_id.name: Backup ID
backup_id.description: Logical Home Assistant backup ID (formerly called slug).

agent_ids.name: Backup agents
agent_ids.description: Optional agent IDs. Leave empty to delete the backup from every registered Backup Agent.

refresh.name: Refresh backup information
refresh.description: Refresh Backup Manager Actions sensors from Home Assistant's Backup Manager.
